questions.question: How does God respond to Jeremiah's intercession in chapter 15?
options: He would graciously spare the whole great city for the sake of ten righteous men
He would at last relent all at once because of Jeremiah's earnest prayer
Even if Moses and Samuel stood before him, he would not turn toward this people
He would send down the rain at last to put an end to the long drought
questions.answer: Even if Moses and Samuel stood before him, he would not turn toward this people

questions.question: How did Jeremiah describe receiving God's words?
options: He wrote them all down on a scroll and then sealed it away
He hid them deep within his heart and told no one at all
He ate them, and they became a joy and delight to his heart
He spoke them out only to the king himself in deep secret
questions.answer: He ate them, and they became a joy and delight to his heart

questions.question: God promises to make Jeremiah a fortified wall of bronze that the people cannot prevail against.
Your words were found, and I ate them, and your words became to me a _____ and the delight of my heart.
They will fight against you, but they shall not prevail, for I am with you to save and _____ you.
